desc:
Build a colossal 10-story treehouse, explore enchanted forests, and pick-sell-farm rare fruits in the great outdoors!

🍎🍏🍎🍏🍎🍏🍎🍏🍎🍏🍎🍏🍎🍏

TreeLands is a retired project and won't be receiving any more updates. We thank you for all your support from over the years. It's been an amazing journey developing the game alongside you, and we hope you treasure the many memories we've made together for the years to come.

Get the Official TreeLands Shirt here: https://www.roblox.com/catalog/717627013/Official-TreeLands-Shirt
